name: MonarchOtpPinInput
title: OTPPinInput
summary: A one-time code or PIN drawn as one cell per character, over a single text field with the one-time code autofill type.
whenToUse: For a verification code sent by text message or email, a PIN, or a short room or invite code of fixed length.
whenNotToUse: For a password use MonarchPasswordInput. For a number with steps use MonarchNumberInput. For a code of unknown length use MonarchTextField.
api: @Composable fun MonarchOtpPinInput(value: String, onValueChange: (String) -> Unit, label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, length: Int = 6, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, mode: MonarchOtpPinInputMode = MonarchOtpPinInputMode.Numeric, size: MonarchOtpPinInputSize = MonarchOtpPinInputSize.Md, enabled: Boolean = true, masked: Boolean = false, groupSize: Int? = null, lengthHint: String? = null, onComplete: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

options.name: value
options.description: The code. Only cleaned text reaches onValueChange: digits, or digits and A to Z in upper case, never longer than length.

options.name: onValueChange
options.description: Called with the cleaned code on every change.

options.name: length
options.description: The number of characters. Values under 1 count as 1.

options.name: errorText
options.description: The error message; replaces the helper text and gives every cell the danger border.

options.name: mode
options.description: Numeric accepts digits with the number keyboard; Alphanumeric accepts A to Z, upper-cased, and digits.

options.name: size
options.description: Md cells are up to 48dp wide and 48dp high; Lg cells up to 64dp with larger characters.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the field can be focused and edited.

options.name: masked
options.description: Shows dots instead of the characters, uses the password transformation and a password keyboard.

options.name: groupSize
options.description: Draws a wider gap after every this many cells. Visual only.

options.name: lengthHint
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken state "Code length: 6".

options.name: onComplete
options.description: Called each time the code reaches length characters, typed, pasted or filled.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the focus interactions of the field.

states.name: empty
states.description: Empty cells with the input border.

states.name: focused
states.description: The cell that takes the next character has a 2dp border in the focus ring color and, while empty, a caret.

states.name: filled
states.description: Each character is drawn in its cell, or as a dot when masked; a filled cell has the subtle text color as its border.

states.name: error
states.description: Every cell has the danger strong border and the message under the cells is in the danger strong color.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Cells use the subtle background, the default border and the disabled text color.

appearance: Cells are the surface color with the input border and medium corners; the active cell's border is the focus ring color, filled cells use the subtle text color for the border, errors the danger strong color. Characters use the default text color with the subheading style (heading at Lg). The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The same single-field design as the web and iOS: one input under drawn cells, so paste, the keyboard and TalkBack treat it as one field. Android uses the Compose SmsOtpCode autofill content type in place of autocomplete="one-time-code". The caret does not blink. Cell sizes are 48dp (Md) and 64dp (Lg) high, taller than the web's 40 and 48 pixels, so the field is a 48dp touch target. The web's hover state and readOnly are not offered. The length is spoken as the field's state description, because Compose has no hint property; iOS speaks it as a hint. Characters typed in other scripts' digits are read as 0 to 9.
accessibility: One TalkBack element, the real text field: the label, the code, the state "Code length: 6", and the error when there is one.
With masked the field is a password field, so the code is not read out.
The error is text under the cells as well as a danger border, not color alone.
The field is at least 48dp high; tapping any cell focuses it.
The cells keep left-to-right order in right-to-left layouts, because a code is read left to right.
Characters and the label scale with the font size setting; cells shrink in width to fit the available width.
edgeCases: Pasting a longer text keeps the first length accepted characters.
A value with characters that are not accepted is shown cleaned.
The cursor always stays at the end of the code; editing in the middle is not possible.
The masked state should not change while the field is shown: Compose keeps the password flag of a text field from its first composition.

examples.title: Verify a code
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
    MonarchOtpPinInput(
        value = code,
        onValueChange = { code = it },
        label = {{label}},
        length = {{length}},
        helperText = {{description}},
    )
    MonarchButton(
        text = {{confirm}},
        onClick = {},
        variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Primary,
        enabled = code.length == {{length}},
    )
}
examples.code:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
    MonarchOtpPinInput(
        value = code,
        onValueChange = { code = it },
        label = "Verification code",
        length = 6,
        helperText = "Try 123456.",
    )
    MonarchButton(
        text = "Confirm",
        onClick = {},
        variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Primary,
        enabled = code.length == 6,
    )
}

examples.title: A masked four-digit PIN
examples.code:
MonarchOtpPinInput(
    value = pin,
    onValueChange = { pin = it },
    label = "PIN",
    length = 4,
    masked = true,
)

examples.title: Letters and digits, large, with an error
examples.code:
MonarchOtpPinInput(
    value = room,
    onValueChange = { room = it },
    label = "Room code",
    length = 4,
    mode = MonarchOtpPinInputMode.Alphanumeric,
    size = MonarchOtpPinInputSize.Lg,
    errorText = "That code has expired.",
)
